record.title: Test the finite 440-store stock table-loop transcript
record.intent: Follow the actual stock software command loop under explicitly synthetic write acceptance.
requirements: Use the controlled executable, pinned transcript, fresh guest and unchanged stock artifacts.
Verify live GOT targets and all111 words of each source table against the pinned input before completing the first modeled write.
Permit only the existing two read responses and exact440-word ordered main-thread store transcript at the witnessed instruction and offset.
Stop immediately on mismatch, other access, signal or bound; after440 stores stop at the following access without answering it.
Capture runtime thread events, terminal state and exact cleanup or preserve an explicit negative outcome and partial evidence.
acceptance: Verify the completed prefix against independently derived stock data and report the next boundary without adaptive transcript growth.
Make no physical ADC, device-ready, timing, DMA or acquisition claim; commit and push the result.
